---
title: "FRESH app privacy policy"
description: "What the FRESH app collects, who processes it, and how to delete it."
date-modified: 2026-11-11
---

Bespoke Analytics, LLC ("we") makes the FRESH app. This policy covers the FRESH app on iPhone, including its TestFlight test builds. Effective 2026-11-11.

FRESH is for people 13 and older.

## What we collect

- **At sign-in:** your name and email address, and the profile details your sign-in method provides (Apple, Google, LinkedIn, or a code sent to your email).
- **What you save to your account:** your chats with FRESH and its replies; the foods you look up; your answers to the setup and food questions, including health conditions, allergies, foods you avoid and any notes you type; the name, size and results of a food log you upload; your recipes, recipe photos, meal plan and commitments; your display settings.
- **Usage events:** for example, a screen opened, a food opened, or a barcode scanned, with the app version and platform. They contain no text you typed.
- **Camera, microphone, speech recognition and photo library:** used only when you scan a food, import or log a meal, add a recipe photo, or choose to let FRESH look at your photos for food preferences.

## Photos

A photo you pick is sent to FRESH to identify a meal, pull out a recipe, or save to a recipe. **Photos you add to a recipe are kept.** While you have an account, they are linked to your recipe and only you can see them, unless you share that recipe. If you delete your account, we remove the link between you and those photos, but we may keep the images, without your name or account, to build a collection of real food pictures that improves FRESH.

## Imported recipes

When you import a recipe from a link, video or text, we process it on our servers. The recipe, its source link, and any video or audio uploaded for it are kept in a recipe collection that is not linked to your account.

## Who processes your data

We use service providers to run FRESH: for sign-in, hosting, databases and file storage, request handling and security, and AI processing. They handle your data only to provide their service to us.

FRESH uses third-party AI services to answer chat questions, read recipes and photos, transcribe the audio of videos you import, and make recipe pictures you ask for. What you send for those features goes to those AI services.

We keep limited technical logs so we can fix problems.

## Your profile in chat

When a question needs it, FRESH's assistant uses your saved profile, such as allergies, foods you avoid and household size. The assistant works under your own sign-in, so it can reach only your data. Anything you type into a chat, including health information, is sent to our AI service providers.

## Sharing

We do not share your chats. If you share a recipe, the person you share it with sees a copy of the recipe and its photo, not your conversation. We do not sell your data.

## Deleting your account

In the app, open your profile, choose **Delete my account**, and type DELETE. Deleting removes your chats, answers (including health conditions), recipes, plan, history, usage records, sign-in, and everything FRESH saved on your phone. It cannot be undone. Recipe photos are handled as described under "Photos".

Some copies of your food-question answers and uploaded food-log results, held for diet calculations, are not yet removed by account deletion. We are fixing this.

To remove an imported recipe from the recipe collection, or for any privacy question, email [josh@freshfoodrecs.com](mailto:josh@freshfoodrecs.com).

## Changes

We will post changes to this policy on this page, with a new date.
